input.description: float tensor or list of tensors to quantize dtype (:class:`torch.dtype`): the desired data type of returned tensor. Has to be one of the quantized dtypes: ``torch.quint8``, ``torch.qint8``

reduce_range.description: a flag to indicate whether to reduce the range of quantized data by 1 bit, it's required to avoid instruction overflow for some hardwares

constraints: input and dtype are positional arguments
